Vermont.focus: Regionalization, shared services, primary care, workforce, price transparency
Vermont.description: Vermont's RHT program advances a suite of reforms to strengthen the rural workforce, increase timely access to care and reduce costs, across five core initiatives.
initiatives: A statewide transformation planning initiative so Vermonters get the right care at the right place and an affordable cost.
Clinically Integrated Network of Shared Services
Shared services for independent hospitals and providers.
Investments including AI scribes, remote patient monitoring and e-Consult.
Health care workforce development, and new accountability tools for price transparency and insurance competition.

Virginia.focus: VA Rural Vitality: CareIQ, Homegrown Health Heroes, Connected Care
Virginia.description: Virginia's VA Rural Vitality plan, led by the Department of Medical Assistance Services, targets more than 1.5 million rural residents through four integrated initiatives.
initiatives: Early-stage health technology startups, EHR and productivity tool modernization and remote patient monitoring.
Rural residencies, allied health apprenticeships, community college programs and high school pathways.
Mobile health and expanded primary, specialty and maternal care close to home.
Reducing chronic disease and improving quality of life.

Washington.focus: Six initiatives from hospital innovation to behavioral health
Washington.description: Washington plans six initiatives to build a healthier, more resilient and financially sustainable rural health system, with partners including the Rural Health Redesign Center and Project ECHO.
initiatives: Igniting innovation and supporting payment transformation in rural hospitals.
Preventing disease and managing care in community settings.
Investments including training capacity for Tribal providers.
AI and cybersecurity, nurse and long-term care workforce, and the rural behavioral health system.

West Virginia.focus: Seven flagship initiatives tying health to workforce participation
West Virginia.description: West Virginia's plan, led by its Department of Health, centers on seven flagship initiatives aimed at the health barriers that hold back workforce participation.
initiatives: Telehealth, remote monitoring and local care coordination, in person and digital.
A one-stop system unifying medical and community transportation.

Wisconsin.description: Wisconsin's Department of Health Services plans three major initiatives focused on rural capacity, sustainability and innovation.
initiatives: Grants for workforce projects, career pathways and community health worker services.
Upgraded provider systems and digital infrastructure, closed-loop referrals, telehealth and a digital rural health care collaborative.
Coordination across primary, specialty and community care, including dental clinic technology grants and veteran and farmer wellness projects.

Wyoming.focus: Right-sized care, workforce pipeline, health outcomes
Wyoming.description: Wyoming's plan, shaped by eleven town halls and a survey of 1,316 residents, focuses on basic access: hospitals that treat emergencies well, ambulances that arrive quickly and whole-person primary care.
initiatives: Helping smaller critical access hospitals focus on core services, regional ambulance consolidation and integrated primary care.
Education support, career pipelines from high school, and broader scope of practice for PAs, dental hygienists and pharmacists.
Diet and exercise promotion, SNAP restrictions on unhealthy food, and statewide telepsychiatry and crisis services.
